message:
The CMakeLists.txt doesn't have ASan flags. The issue is that the top-level CMakeLists.txt might have them. Let me check:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'grep -n "sanitize\|CFLAGS\|CMAKE_C_FLAGS" /gt/_work/src/CMakeLists.txt | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
